# Runs a PyTorch script from the existing venv. Prints exactly one JSON line.
esc(s) = replace(s, "\\" => "\\\\", "\"" => "\\\"", "\n" => "\\n", "\r" => "", "\t" => " ")
try
    dir = mktempdir()
    py = joinpath(dir, "torch_job.py")
    write(py, raw"""import json, time, socket
out = {"host": socket.gethostname()}
try:
    import torch
    out["torch"] = torch.__version__
    out["torch_cuda_build"] = torch.version.cuda
    out["cuda_available"] = torch.cuda.is_available()
    dev = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    out["device"] = torch.cuda.get_device_name(0) if dev.type == "cuda" else "cpu"

    # 1) GPU matmul sanity check
    a = torch.arange(1, 5, dtype=torch.float32, device=dev).reshape(2, 2)
    out["matmul"] = (a @ a).cpu().tolist()          # [[7,10],[15,22]]

    # 2) Tiny training loop: fit y = 3x + 2
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    x = torch.linspace(-1, 1, 256, device=dev).unsqueeze(1)
    y = 3 * x + 2 + 0.01 * torch.randn_like(x)
    model = torch.nn.Linear(1, 1).to(dev)
    opt = torch.optim.SGD(model.parameters(), lr=0.1)
    t0 = time.time()
    for _ in range(200):
        opt.zero_grad()
        loss = torch.nn.functional.mse_loss(model(x), y)
        loss.backward()
        opt.step()
    if dev.type == "cuda":
        torch.cuda.synchronize()
    out["fit"] = {"weight": model.weight.item(), "bias": model.bias.item(),
                  "final_loss": loss.item(), "seconds": round(time.time() - t0, 3)}
    out["on_device"] = next(model.parameters()).device.type
except Exception as e:
    import traceback
    out["error"] = repr(e)
    out["traceback"] = traceback.format_exc()[-1500:]
print(json.dumps(out))
""")
    errf = joinpath(dir, "py.err")
    cmd = `bash -c "source /scratch/coop/drozda/torch-env/bin/activate && python $py 2>$errf"`
    raw = read(ignorestatus(cmd), String)
    lines = filter(!isempty, strip.(split(raw, '\n')))
    if !isempty(lines) && startswith(last(lines), "{")
        println(last(lines))
    else
        err = isfile(errf) ? read(errf, String) : ""
        println("{\"error\":\"no JSON from python\",\"stdout\":\"", esc(raw[max(1,end-1500):end]), "\",\"stderr\":\"", esc(err[max(1,end-1500):end]), "\"}")
    end
catch e
    println("{\"error\":\"", esc(sprint(showerror, e)), "\"}")
end
